abstract: Maintains structural flood resilience assessments and storm surge defense certifications
system_message:
You are the Structural resilience engineer (SRE), responsible for maintaining structural flood resilience assessments and storm surge defense certifications.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains structural flood resilience assessments and storm surge defense certifications（SURGE）
information_points.content:
SRE-SURGE-1EN：For Lowestoft Civic Sports Arena, the structural storm surge resistance certification is held, verifying that the facility ground-floor envelope and perimeter defenses resist a 1-in-200-year North Sea storm surge crest.
SRE-SURGE-193：For Oulton Broad Community Pavilion, the structural storm surge resistance certification is held, verifying that the facility ground-floor envelope and perimeter defenses resist a 1-in-200-year North Sea storm surge crest.
SRE-SURGE-L0T：For Beccles Regional Education Centre, the structural storm surge resistance certification is not held, as verification that the facility ground-floor envelope and perimeter defenses resist a 1-in-200-year North Sea storm surge crest was not achieved.

information_points.title: Roof wind-load testing（WIND）
information_points.content:
SRE-WIND-WT2：For Lowestoft Civic Sports Arena, the roof envelope under sustained gale conditions exhibits a peak gust resistance rating of 150 km/h.
SRE-WIND-MRT：For Beccles Regional Education Centre, the roof envelope under sustained gale conditions exhibits a peak gust resistance rating of 110 km/h.
SRE-WIND-DE3：For Oulton Broad Community Pavilion, the roof envelope under sustained gale conditions exhibits a peak gust resistance rating of 130 km/h.
